title: Fractions on a Number Line

serves.summary: The learner partitions 0 to 1 into equal parts and drags a marker to a fraction (including fractions greater than 1 and equivalent fractions) on a number line.

request.objective: Partition the interval from 0 to 1 into equal parts and place a fraction on the number line (3.NF.A.2)

problems.ask: Put the marker at 3/4 on the number line.
problems.goal: Each whole has 4 equal parts and the marker is on the third tick.

problems.ask: Put the marker at 2/3 on the number line.
problems.goal: Each whole has 3 equal parts and the marker is on the second tick.

problems.ask: Put the marker at 5/4 on the number line.
problems.goal: Each whole has 4 equal parts and the marker is on the fifth tick, past 1.

problems.ask: Split each whole into sixths and put the marker at a point equal to 1/2.
problems.goal: Each whole has 6 equal parts and the marker is on the third tick.
